findings.title: Topic-meta link light-theme color inverted, leaving near-invisible contrast
findings.description: The light arm of `.topic-meta-data h5 a` changed from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` to `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)`, so the pair is now 70%/30%. Emphasized text elsewhere uses 30%/70% (for example `.username a` in `common/base/user.scss:119`). With the default colors, the light arm is now about #bdbdbd on white, roughly 1.9:1 contrast, down from about 5.9:1 for the original 30%. This link is bold, so the regression is legibility, not just style. Restore `color: dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%));`.

findings.title: Mobile custom-message hint no longer matches desktop
findings.description: The light arm of `.custom-message-length` changed from 70% to 30%, so the hint text now renders dark instead of muted. The desktop rule at `app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/modal.scss:94` keeps the original 70%/30% pair. Restore the mobile line to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))` to match desktop.

findings.title: Mobile topic-map heading loses contrast and breaks the mirror pair
findings.description: In `.topic-map h3`, the light arm changed from 20% to 50%, and the dark arm is 50%, so the two arms are no longer mirrored. Light-theme heading contrast drops from about 8.3:1 to about 3.2:1. The desktop equivalent at `app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/topic-post.scss:321` uses 20%/80%. Restore `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 80%))`.

findings.title: Group-member name is now the same color as the title
findings.description: In `.group-member-info`, `.name` changed its light arm from 30% to 50%. That makes it the same expression as `.title` on line 527, so the name no longer stands out, and its light contrast drops from about 5.9:1 to about 3.2:1. The base `.name` rule in `common/base/user.scss:124` uses 30%/70%. The same change appears in `app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/user.scss:497` (`.group-member-info .name`), and both should be restored to 30%/70%.

findings.title: The 50%/50% color pair is hand-copied across many stylesheets
findings.description: The expression `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))` appears 57 times across 24 stylesheets under `app/assets/stylesheets` (grep count, which includes lines not touched by this diff). The errors in the findings above came from hand-typing these pairs. A shared variable or helper for muted text would make the pairs easier to audit. This is not required for this change.
